author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not widen a public function's type parameters to `any` while refactoring; keep the specific inferred type.
fix_shape: replace the `any` type argument with the concrete or generic type it stood in for

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep type-only or regular imports at the top of the file rather than inlined at point of use.
fix_shape: move the import statement to the file's top-level import block

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a public API surface for a capability that has no demonstrated need yet.
fix_shape: remove the speculative API, or justify it with a concrete caller

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not export functions as part of a package's public API when only the package's own internals call them.
fix_shape: stop exporting the internal-only functions, or move them into an internal module

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer invalidating derived/cached state by versioning its identifier (e.g. an index name) over a hand-written one-time backfill migration.
fix_shape: append a version suffix to the derived artifact's name so a schema change invalidates it automatically

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not bolt a concern that is unrelated to a component's core responsibility onto it (e.g. a merge-intent queue inside an indexer); give the concern its own module.
fix_shape: extract the unrelated table/logic into a separate module owned by the concern it actually serves

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a module needs several injected dependencies (e.g. a host, an indexer, a query engine), structure it as a class taking those deps in its constructor rather than as loose functions closing over ad hoc context objects.
fix_shape: convert the function module into a class whose constructor takes the dependencies

author: richburdon
principle: Application and SDK code must not import from a package's internal module when a suitable public API equivalent already exists.
fix_shape: import the public API export instead of reaching into the internal path

author: richburdon
principle: Do not export an identifier from a module unless something outside the module actually needs it.
fix_shape: drop the export keyword and keep the symbol module-private

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place runtime-specific behavior (like a startup delay) in the layer that owns that runtime, not in a shared host class used by every runtime.
fix_shape: move the constant/logic down into the runtime-specific module that owns the concern

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer explicit construction-time configuration over a runtime fallback timer or flag to sequence one-time startup behavior.
fix_shape: add a constructor option instead of a scheduled fallback callback

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extend the existing query DSL to express a new capability rather than building a parallel ad hoc type or option beside it.
fix_shape: fold the new option into Filter/Query instead of a standalone type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A new query capability belongs on the existing Filter API, not on a separate scope-specific option.
fix_shape: move the option onto Filter rather than a bespoke Scope parameter

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not mix Effect-based and plain Promise-based methods on the same interface; once an interface goes Effect, use Effect's own lifecycle primitives (e.g. Scope.Scope) rather than ad hoc open/close methods.
fix_shape: convert the remaining Promise-returning methods to Effect and use Scope for lifecycle

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent a typed, well-known piece of schema metadata as a dedicated schema annotation rather than overloading a generic key/value mechanism like meta.key.
fix_shape: define a dedicated annotation for the field instead of storing it as a generic meta key

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a bounded-range options object (e.g. {begin, end}) over a single one-sided parameter when a function may need to be extended to both bounds.
fix_shape: change the parameter to an options bag with named begin/end fields

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse an existing accessor helper instead of re-deriving the same value inline.
fix_shape: call the existing helper function rather than duplicating its logic

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain's branded/canonical type for a parameter rather than accepting the underlying primitive (e.g. a bare string).
fix_shape: change the parameter type to the branded domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a plain SQL migration over a programmatic/conditional one whenever the change can be expressed directly in SQL.
fix_shape: rewrite the conditional migration logic as a declarative SQL statement

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a plain SQL migration over a programmatic/conditional one whenever the change can be expressed directly in SQL.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not repeat the namespace's name inside an exported member's name (e.g. StateStore.StateStore); export it so the namespace prefix alone reads naturally.
fix_shape: rename the member so it does not duplicate its containing namespace

author: denjell-crabnebula
principle: A new file's copyright header must credit its actual author, not default boilerplate for the org.
fix_shape: set the copyright line to the contributing author's name

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not repeat the same explanatory comment at every call site; centralize it in one place and reference it from the others.
fix_shape: write the explanation once at its canonical location and point other sites at it

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When the same exception is special-cased in multiple places, fold it into the general mechanism it is bypassing instead of repeating the special case.
fix_shape: generalize the shared mechanism to cover the case rather than special-casing each site

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid introducing a new named concept or verb when an existing mechanism's syntax can be extended to express the same thing.
fix_shape: express the new behavior through the existing task/verb syntax instead of defining a new one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not create separate categories or tags for cases that behave identically; collapse them into one.
fix_shape: merge the redundant categories/tags into a single one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove a configuration escape hatch or flag that nothing in the repo actually uses rather than keeping it as dead-but-working code.
fix_shape: delete the unused flag/branch and its handling

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Isolate one-time setup cost out of a benchmark or test's measured block using proper setup hooks (beforeEach/beforeAll) rather than lazy-memoized inline initialization inside the measured function.
fix_shape: move the setup code into a beforeEach/beforeAll hook so it is not attributed to the measured operation
